record.original_question: Let X be a smooth projective complex curve of genus g >= 3, let G be a finite group acting faithfully on X, and let sigma be the signature of the G-action. Describe the locus M_g(G,sigma) of curves in the genus-g moduli space M_g with automorphism group/action data (G,sigma) in terms of theta-null data.

evidence.quote: We denote by Mg(G, σ) be the sublocus in Mg of all the genus g curves X with G ,→ Aut (X ) and signature σ.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $g \geq 3$ be an integer and let $\mathcal{M}_g$ denote the coarse moduli space of smooth projective curves of genus $g$ over $\mathbb{C}$. For a smooth projective complex curve $X$ of genus $g$ and a finite group $G$ acting faithfully on $X$, the signature of the action is the tuple $\sigma = (g_0; m_1, \ldots, m_r)$, where $g_0$ is the genus of the quotient $X/G$ and $m_1, \ldots, m_r$ are the orders of the (non-trivial) stabilizers at the branch points of the quotient map $X \to X/G$. Define
$$\mathcal{M}_g(G,\sigma) = \{[X] \in \mathcal{M}_g : G \hookrightarrow \operatorname{Aut}(X) \text{ with signature } \sigma\}.$$

Recall that for a principally polarized abelian variety $(A,\Theta)$ of dimension $g$ with a chosen symplectic basis, the theta nulls are the values $\theta\!\left[{a \atop b}\right](0,\tau)$ at the origin of the Riemann theta functions with half-integer characteristics $a,b \in \tfrac{1}{2}\mathbb{Z}^g/\mathbb{Z}^g$, evaluated at the period matrix $\tau$ in the Siegel upper half-space $\mathfrak{H}_g$. Via the Torelli map $\mathcal{M}_g \to \mathcal{A}_g$, these provide coordinates (modulo the action of $\operatorname{Sp}(2g,\mathbb{Z})$) on the image of $\mathcal{M}_g$.

Problem. For every triple $(g, G, \sigma)$ with $g \geq 3$, give an explicit description of the locus $\mathcal{M}_g(G,\sigma)$ in terms of equations, vanishing conditions, and algebraic relations among the theta nulls of the corresponding Jacobians.
artifact.category_tag: Moduli of curves and theta nulls
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of describing automorphism loci $\mathcal{M}_g(G,\sigma)$ of curves in $\mathcal{M}_g$ via theta nulls is an active research direction; explicit descriptions exist only in low genus and for special families (e.g., hyperelliptic and certain superelliptic cases, work of Shaska and collaborators), and no general description for arbitrary $(g,G,\sigma)$ is known.
